description: IGI Holdings Limited is the listed holding company of the IGI insurance group and a Packages Group company, incorporated in 1953 as IGI Insurance Limited. Following schemes of amalgamation and arrangement sanctioned by the Sindh High Court in December 2017, IGI Investment Bank Limited amalgamated into it and its insurance business was transferred to a wholly-owned subsidiary, IGI General Insurance Limited, leaving IGI Holdings as an investment holding company. It is registered and headquartered in Karachi and has a branch in Lahore.
headOffice: 7th Floor, The Forum, Suite 701-713, G-20, Block 9, Khayaban-e-Jami, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
